crossRefs.note: They took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came to the wilderness of Sin…
Moreover, in a pillar of cloud you led them by day; and in a pillar of fire by night, to give them light in the way in…
In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.
He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.
As an eagle that stirs up her nest, that flutters over her young, he spread abroad his wings, he took them, he bore…
Yahweh alone led him. There was no foreign god with him.
‘You have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and how I bore you on eagles’ wings, and brought you to myself.
Moses said to Yahweh, “Why have you treated your servant so badly? Why haven’t I found favor in your sight, that you…
Have I conceived all this people? Have I brought them out, that you should tell me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a…
I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.
He will feed his flock like a shepherd. He will gather the lambs in his arm, and carry them in his bosom. He will…
“Listen to me, house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, that have been carried from their birth…
Even to old age I am he, and even to gray hairs I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear. Yes, I will carry, and…
In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them. In his love and in his pity he…
Yet I taught Ephraim to walk. I took them by his arms; but they didn’t know that I healed them.
I drew them with cords of a man, with ties of love; and I was to them like those who lift up the yoke on their necks…
For a period of about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness.

translations.web: and in the wilderness where you have seen how that Yahweh your God carried you, as a man carries his son, in all the way that you went, until you came to this place.”
translations.bsb: and in the wilderness, where the LORD your God carried you, as a man carries his son, all the way by which you traveled until you reached this place.”
translations.kjv: And in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that the LORD thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came into this place.
translations.asv: and in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that Jehovah thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came unto this place.
